description: "Don Garcia of Navarre; Or, the Jealous Prince" is a heroic comedy written by Molière in the early 17th century. This play delves into themes of jealousy and romantic entanglement, centering around the character Don Garcia, a prince whose love for Donna Elvira is overshadowed by his insecurities and suspicion of rival suitors.
